Class CardDrawer

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.CardDrawer
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardVisitor
public class CardDrawer extends Object implements CardVisitor
Executes the acquisition of a card from the board, managing the transfer of the card to the player's tribe and the application of associated costs and effects. Acting as a state-mutating Visitor, this class leverages double-dispatch to process different card types safely without explicit casting:
  • Character Cards: Removed from the board, registered to the player's tribe, and immediately trigger any active OnAcquireBuildingEffect.
  • Building Cards: Validates the player's food reserves, deducts the appropriately discounted cost, removes the card from the board, and registers it.
  • Event Cards: Throws an IllegalStateException since event cards are resolved automatically by the game engine and cannot be manually drawn.

This handler gracefully adapts to contexts where a standard OfferTileAction is absent (e.g., during the end-of-round bonus draft), applying the base acquisition logic without tile-specific modifiers.

    • visit

      public void visit(CharacterCard card)
      Executes the acquisition pipeline for a Character Card.

      The process guarantees the following sequence:

      1. Application of the current tile's draw action (if present).

      2. Removal of the card from the board.

      3. Registration of the card into the player's tribe.

      4. Resolution of any active OnAcquireBuildingEffect triggered by this addition.

      Specified by:
      visit in interface CardVisitor
      Parameters:
      card - the character card being acquired.

    • visit

      public void visit(BuildingCard card)
      Handles the transactional acquisition of a Building Card.

      Acts by enforcing food availability pre-conditions. If the player possesses sufficient food (after applying any discounts), the cost is deducted, the card is removed from the board and registered to the player's tribe.

      Specified by:
      visit in interface CardVisitor
      Parameters:
      card - the building card being acquired.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the player's food is strictly less than the card's discounted cost.
